info.description:
Read-only translation surface for the Wuthering Waves terminology service.

This API uses the application pipeline also used by Telegram command routes
and the in-process private web layer: official dictionary hit first, then a
trusted pinyin hit, then a dictionary-guided model call with official terms
supplied as contextual references. Linked-channel
auto-translation has specialized channel orchestration and is not part of this
API contract. Responses are plain text; rich-text markup is never part of this
contract.

Authentication is a bearer device token issued by the operator. There is no
registration endpoint: tokens are created out of band and can be revoked.
info.title: wuwaterm API

get.description: Liveness. Answers as long as the process is serving; no auth.
Readiness: the terminology database is readable right now. No auth.

503.description: The terminology database is not readable. Classified as `internal`; the 503 status is what distinguishes it.

get.description:
Verify an active meta-scoped credential without a business quota debit.

Each request performs full credential verification and uses the shared
verification concurrency limit. Probes have an independent per-device
limit of 120 per minute and do not update last-used time. Responses,
including errors, carry Cache-Control: no-store.

204.description: Credential is active and has the meta scope

503.description: A dependency this request needs is temporarily unavailable: the translation model, the credential store, or the post-admission device re-check. Classified as `llm_unavailable` or `internal`; the 503 status is what distinguishes it from a genuine 500. Retryable.

504.description: Request exceeded the server time budget. Classified as `internal`: the enumerated code set is closed, so the HTTP status is what distinguishes a timeout from a genuine 500.

post.description:
Model-backed semantic issues for one paired segment (semantic-review-v1).

Separate from `/v1/reviews`: it never returns a verdict and never
produces `verified_constraint`. Each side is at most 2,000 Unicode
scalars; a longer side is `input_too_long` (422), as on `/v1/reviews`.
Use it only when `GET /v1/capabilities` lists `semantic-review-v1`;
otherwise it answers `llm_unavailable` (503) without calling a model.
Semantic review is experimental and off by default
(`WUWATERM_SEMANTIC_REVIEW_ENABLED`). At most one model call per request, counted against the same budget,
concurrency limit and per-device limit as translation. Model output
that fails validation is not retried: HTTP 200 with
`status: not_reviewed`.
